conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.1/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/recycle_bin/checklist/list_sections?page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&filters%5Bid%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&filters%5Bupdated_at%5D=SOME_STRING_VALUE&filters%5Blist_id%5D=SOME_ARRAY_VALUE&sort=SOME_STRING_VALUE", headers=headers)
